details.detail: Aisle vault: the arch, the 2-frame panel pitch and the fade toward the crease still read right. FIXED: the 8 mm lighter joints no longer break into dotted lines at distance (q15/v3/v5 show continuous soft arcs). They also cross the grille as a solid bridge and run onto the diffuser, as in b_sany_y22 (y22_cove). Remaining difference: in b_sany_y22 and c119 each joint is a raised light rib that sweeps aft along the centre-bin side. In the model it is a plain transverse arc. The vault also falls off less than in the photos. b_sany_y22 runs 233 to 150 from the grille to the crease. v6 runs 251 to 217 and is flat at 217-219 over its inboard half.

Slotted grille: FIXED segment length. There are now 2 segments per panel, with bridges aligned to the panel joints (v2_grille, p1). New relative-proportion issue: the grille is too wide and too contrasty for the band beside it. In y22_cove the grille is a slim mid-grey strip (average about #606060, narrow slits) about 1/4 the width of the lit band. In the model it is 0.08 m of pure black slits between white bars (luminance 70 against 220), roughly as wide as the diffuser. It reads as a zebra stripe and is the most prominent thing on the ceiling.

Cove light: MUCH IMPROVED. A continuous near-white diffuser now runs between the bin crest and the grille (v6, p1, g_latch), and the lighting finally reads as a 777 Signature cove. Two gaps remain against y22_cove and c119. (1) Width: in the photos the band is 3-4x the grille width (c119 y=100: band 115 px against grille 40 px; y22 about 100 px against 25 px). In the model it is 1-1.7x (v2 y=100: 40 px against 40 px; v6_cove about 1.3x). From aisle views looking up, part of it hides behind the crest. (2) The glow is on the wrong side. In the photos the band (255) is the brightest thing, and the vault just inboard of the grille is clearly lower (233 falling off). In the model the vault inboard of the grille is as bright as the band (v2 251 against 252; v6 251), so the grille looks as if it sits in the middle of a light band rather than at its edge.

Outboard bins: still right (2-frame modules, one latch, one placard, light hairline seams). FIXED: with the rail lowered to 2.105 the placard now faces the aisle and reads '35 ▭▭▭' from the aisle (p1), as with '32' in b_sany_y22.

Centre bins: the shape, the 0.48 m channel, the black channel edges and the broad wrap all match b_sany_y22 and y_47300. REGRESSION in tonal modelling: the brighter doorC (e 0.14) and bandC (e 0.12) push both into the ACES shoulder. v1 and v6 render the doors at a constant 219 and the channel at a constant 215, the same value over hundreds of pixels, so the bulge has no form and the channel is not recessed. Photos: y_47300 upper door 245-250, lower wrap about 200-205, channel 184-195 (channel/door about 0.76). c119 door face ranges 72-175. In r2 the ratio was 182/193 (0.94); in r3 it is 215/219 (0.98).
Latches: stadium plate, dark well and lever. The latch at y 2.03 sits correctly about 45 % down the door (p1, g_latch).

Outboard PSU: the stadium wells alternating lights and gaspers are right in plan. Close up (v4, v9) the wells are flat grey plates (#bebfc1 on a #d6d6d5 band) with a hard darker outline, and read like stickers. In thrifty_j_overhead-vent the well is the same plastic as the band, and it reads through a sculpted recess with a soft raised lip and its own shading. Each well and sign also sits in a separate, slightly proud filler module with shadowed gaps. The model's band is one flat plate with hairline joints. New artefact: a 1-2 px light-blue hairline runs along the band's outboard edge and at the module gaps (v4 (570-930, 540-565): (197,225,244); v9 (0-520, 378)).

Centre PSU channel: FIXED slatting. The channel joints are now irregular, and the stadium with 4 round fittings at the top of v6 sits exactly where b_sany_y22 has its 4-gasper stadium (photo 660-920 at y 40-90; v6 520-735 at y 10-40). The long smoked sign pill matches the photo at (620-730, 275). Minor: b_sany_y22's joints come as close-spaced pairs (y 115/135, 210/235, 300/320). The model's are single lines.
Signs: smoked pills with amber icons, both on the centre channel and on the outboard band, as in b_sany_y22 and thrifty.

Row placards: the outboard placard faces the aisle and is readable (p1). The centre placard is on the door top, lifted to match the door (p2). The raised rail on the centre door seen in c119 is still missing, but that is minor.
Ceiling EXIT signs: light box reading '← 非常口 EXIT →' at the zone ends (v3, v7). This matches b_sany_y22 (430,355).

Speaker and emergency fittings: FIXED. The speaker is a rounded rectangle with a thin rim and a perforated field (v2, h_trough), which matches c119 (420-570, 0-80). The emergency light is a light frame round a grey lens, which matches the small rectangles in c119.

Door-area ceilings: the header closures cut my round-2 leak from 229 sky-tinted pixels to 54 in v3, but a sliver remains at v3 (360-380, 300-310), about (221,230,238), where the centre-bin end meets the vault header and the dome. The door-3 black-edged canopy (v3, top left) is a monument and has been handed to them. The q01 camera is still between monument walls (integration). The dome, downlight, light strips and EXIT box are otherwise fine (v7).

mostly fixed: 229 px down to 54 px in v3; a small sliver remains at the centre-bin end (low)

issues.detail: Cove band too narrow relative to the grille, and the glow is on both sides of the grille, not just outboard of it.
issues.problem: Lighting proportion. This is the signature 777 cove: in the photos a broad saturated band ends sharply at a slim grey grille, and the vault beyond is visibly dimmer. In the model the band and grille are the same width and the vault just inboard is just as bright.
issues.evidence: cove_pair.png (left b_sany_y22, right v6). c119 y=100: band 115 px at 246, grille 40 px, vault 196 then falling. v2 y=100: band 738-750 (about 12-40 px) at 252, grille 700-725, vault inboard 251. 07b: TROUGH.cove [0.015, 0.16], grille at t 0.20, w 0.08 plus a 0.024 rim.
issues.fix: 07b_ceiling.js: TROUGH = { ts: [0.24], w: 0.05, seg: 2, gap: 0.025, cove: [0.0, 0.215] } so the diffuser fills the crest-to-grille span, about 4x a 5 cm grille. troughRim width to TROUGH.w + 0.012. In the vault eFn, cap the glow inboard of the grille at about 0.55 of the outboard plateau and fall off over about 0.25 m (for example, inboard of xg return 0.5 * exp(-d / 0.25) in place of the current 'extra glow beside the grille'), so the band stays the brightest element. Check that the speaker at tc 0.78 still clears.

issues.detail: Centre-bin doors and PSU channel render as flat constant tones (219 and 215) with no form and no recess.
issues.problem: Materials and lighting regression: the doorC/bandC self-lift pushes them into the ACES shoulder, so the baked shadeUpper gradient (1.0 to 0.95) is lost and the channel is not darker than the doors.
issues.evidence: v1 rows 30-250: the channel is exactly 215 across x 360-620 and the doors 219-220. v6: the channel is 215 from 468 to 756. y_47300: upper door 245-250, lower wrap 200-205, channel 184-195 (0.76). r2 was 182/193.
issues.fix: 08_bins.js: BINMAT.bandC = { c: '#d4d4d2', r: 0.5, l: LAYER.plastic, e: 0.05 } (the channel is then about 0.8-0.85 of the door). Give shadeUpper a floor parameter and call it with 0.86 for the centre module: in shadeUpper(geo, lo = 0.95) use lerp(1.0, lo, ...), and in centerBinModule use `return shadeUpper(B.build(), 0.86)`. Keep doorC e at 0.14 or lower it to 0.10 so the upper face stays near white while the down-facing wrap goes grey, as in y_47300.

issues.detail: The grille is a wide black-and-white zebra strip. In reality it is a slim mid-grey slot grille.
issues.problem: Proportion and colour contrast: the grille is the most eye-catching element on the ceiling.
issues.evidence: y22_cove: slim grille, average about #606060, narrow slits. v2_grille / p1: 5 near-black slits (luminance 70) between white bars (220), 0.08 m wide.
issues.fix: 07b_ceiling.js: TROUGH.w 0.05 (see the cove fix). Set CEILMAT.trough (the slit ground) to about #55595e rather than near-black, and draw 4 slits in ATL.rects.grille with bars about as wide as the slits.

issues.detail: The outboard PSU wells are flat grey plates with a hard rim and read as stickers. The band has no proud filler modules.
issues.evidence: v4_psu: well #bebfc1 on band #d6d6d5 with a dark outline. thrifty_j_overhead-vent: the well is the same plastic as the band, reading through a sculpted soft lip and shading, and each module is proud with shadowed gaps.
issues.fix: 08_bins.js: BINMAT.well c '#dcdcd9' e 0.12 (close to the band). Make wellRim a lighter lip, c '#eeeeec' with width w + 0.012, plus a thin inner shadow ring '#b8bbbe' 2 mm inside. In sideBinModule add a proud pad per window bay: B.add(gRBox(bw - 0.04, 0.004, 0.27, 0.004, 1), M4.trs(bx * side, by - 0.002, z, 0, 0, -TILT_O * side), BINMAT.band) at z = ±L/4, with BINMAT.groove strips 3 mm wide at the pad ends in place of the 4 hairline joints.

issues.detail: A light-blue hairline leak runs along the outboard edge of the PSU band and at the module gaps.
issues.evidence: v4 (570-930, 540-565) (197,225,244), 949 px; v9 (0-520, 378). It appears where the sidewall-wash lens housing meets the sidewall, and at the 3 cm lens gap and the 4-6 mm band and carcass gaps between modules.
issues.fix: 08_bins.js sideBinModule: build the band at gBox(bw + 0.03, 0.004, L) (no -0.004, extending outboard to meet the sidewall), the carcass gExtrude at depth L, and the wash lens at depth L - 0.004. Add a white closing strip under the lens, gBox(0.06, 0.004, L) at (2.83 * side, 1.600), MAT.bin. If the gap is on the shell side, pass it to 07_shell.

issues.detail: A residual sky sliver remains at the seat-zone and door-zone boundary beside the centre-bin end.
issues.fix: 07b_ceiling.js: take the header closure up to the centre-bin crest and past it (VAULT end point to [0.62, 2.30] and [0, 2.315] as in CBIN_Q), extruded 0.02 m past the zone end so it overlaps the dome and MONOC. Alternatively, cap the centre-bin run ends in 08_bins with a gExtrude of CBIN_Q at 0.004 m.

issues.detail: The vault joints are plain transverse arcs. In the photos they are raised light ribs that sweep aft toward the centre bin.
issues.evidence: y22_cove: the joint crosses the vault and curves aft along the centre-bin crest. c119 likewise.
issues.fix: 07b_ceiling.js profileRibbon: offset z by +0.25 * smoothstep(0.6, 1, k / (prof.length - 1)) over the inboard 40 % of the profile, and give the ribbon a 1 mm proud lighter top (#f4f4f2) with a 2 mm darker (#c8cacc) shadow edge on its aft side.
